The Life page is in demo mode, showing a set of sample records as a reference for what you can record. They behave exactly like your own: you can open, edit or delete them, and they are included in backups and exports. If you don\'t need them, turn off "Demo Mode" in Settings — the samples will then be removed, so they won\'t appear on any page or in backups. Turning it back on generates a fresh set.

Four things to know before you start
Your Data Stays on This Phone
No network, no collection, no upload — the app declares no network permission.
A Forgotten Master Password Cannot Be Recovered
It protects your vault and encrypted backups and is stored only on this device. Please remember it.
Uninstalling or Clearing Data Erases Everything
This device holds the only copy — there is no cloud to restore from.
Exported backups require a password of at least 6 characters; forgetting it is equally unrecoverable.
Tip: remember your PIN. Forgetting it requires resetting your data.
